description.value: The Orca Inn is a historic inn in Alert Bay dating to the 1930s, occupying two former buildings from the community's fishing-industry heyday. It offers a range of rooms and suites — several with ocean views where Orca whales are sometimes spotted — along with an on-site pub featuring live music. The inn is run by a hands-on owner and sits in one of BC's most culturally rich island communities, home to the U'Mista Cultural Centre.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms the address (291 Fir St, Alert Bay), free WiFi, and an on-site restaurant and pub. The Family Suite description explicitly states 'The street level door has storage for camping gear or bicycles,' providing positive evidence of bike storage, though it is suite-specific and not described as locked. No evidence on the website addresses staff bike procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or most other amenities beyond WiFi and on-site food.
concerns: Bike storage is explicitly mentioned only for the Family Suite; other room types do not reference bike storage on the website.
OSM tags the property as 'hotel' but the OSM description says 'Bed & Breakfast and a nice Pub'; the website does not clearly use either label. Category is left as Accommodation.
Phone number not visibly displayed on the fetched website pages; could not confirm it matches OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active accommodation in Alert Bay with confirmed bike storage (Family Suite), on-site pub/restaurant, and free WiFi — a clear fit for touring cyclists visiting this remote island community.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Family Suite street-level storage is the strongest cyclist-relevant feature; operators should be asked whether storage is accessible to guests in other room types as well.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: Family Suite listing states: 'The street level door has storage for camping gear or bicycles.' Storage is inside the building at street level; specific to the Family Suite and not described as locked

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site pub and restaurant: 'Enjoy our outstanding restaurant and pub.' Pub is open Friday and Saturday nights
